segments.name: Unum US
products: Group life and accidental death and dismemberment
segments.description: Provides group disability, group life, and supplemental voluntary employee benefit insurance products to U.S. employers.
segments.evidence: Our Unum US segment is comprised of group disability, group life and accidental death and dismemberment, and supplemental and voluntary lines of business.

segments.name: Unum International
segments.description: Provides employee benefit insurance products in the United Kingdom and Poland.
segments.evidence: We are a leading provider of financial protection benefits in the United States and the United Kingdom.

segments.name: Colonial Life
segments.description: Provides employee benefit insurance products through workplace channels.
segments.evidence: Our reportable segments are comprised of the following: Unum US, Unum International, Colonial Life, Closed Block, and Corporate.

segments.name: Closed Block
segments.description: Manages in-force policies from insurance products no longer actively marketed.
segments.evidence: Our reportable segments are comprised of the following: Unum US, Unum International, Colonial Life, Closed Block, and Corporate.

revenueModel.text: Employers pay premiums for group insurance products based on expected claims, administrative expenses, investment income and profit; individual policies and fee-based services generate revenue similarly.
revenueModel.evidence: Premiums for group long-term and short-term disability are generally based on expected claims of a pool of similar risks plus provisions for administrative expenses, investment income, and profit.

changes.text: In 2024, medical stop-loss product was no longer actively marketed as of the third quarter.
changes.evidence: Also included in our long-term disability product line is our medical stop-loss product, which was no longer actively marketed as of the third quarter of 2024.
